\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
We study polynomials over $\R$.
\begin{definition}\label{def:root}
A \emph{root} of $p$ is a zero of $p$ in $\R$.
\end{definition}
\begin{theorem}
Every polynomial of odd degree has a root.
\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:small}
A root of $p$ is a root of $p^2$.
\end{lemma}
